summary: Direct uploaded launch to Map can remain stuck behind Processing Files
fixture_or_context: COVID-19_simulated_NodeList_snp.csv + COVID_Dummy_distance_edgelist_snp.csv with File Settings default view = Map
observed_behavior: When this uploaded fixture is launched with default view set to Map, the app can leave the Processing Files dialog visible indefinitely instead of finishing the launch. The failure was observed while Map was requesting zipcodes.csv and never reached the maintained assertions.
intended_behavior: The Processing Files dialog should clear and the uploaded network should reach an interactive Map view on the direct-launch path.
cause_summary: Not fixed yet. The direct Map launch path appears to interact badly with Map startup work for zipcode-based rendering on this fixture.
fix_summary: Maintained Map coverage currently uses the stable path of launching the network first and then switching to Map. Once the direct-launch bug is fixed, add a dedicated maintained smoke for that path and update tracker row M011.
